name: hansharhoff-skills
description: Personal Claude Code skills marketplace by Hans Harhoff Andersen

plugins.name: teach-tech
plugins.description: Interactive technology teaching sessions — guides you through new technologies with explanations, diagrams, and hands-on exercises

plugins.name: repo-cleanup
plugins.description: Audit and clean up a repository: find typos, inconsistencies, outdated references, dead code, failing tests, type errors, linter issues, and documentation gaps

plugins.name: spec-driven-workflow
plugins.description: Iterate code against a spec maintained in a separate location. Snapshot-based diff drives each iteration's work plan; bookkeeping (status, blocked items, happy path) lives in the code repo's spec/working folder.

plugins.name: tailscale-served-dashboard
plugins.description: Turn a locally-running web app or dashboard on a Mac into a durable, tailnet-reachable service: bind 127.0.0.1, front it with tailscale serve (HTTPS), and supervise it with a launchd LaunchDaemon. Includes scaffold.sh to generate the run script, daemon plist, and installer.

plugins.name: whats-next
plugins.description: PM-style triage + capture for the active workspace. READ mode renders a ranked dashboard of open PRs, in-session tasks, scheduled memory items, Atlassian (when MCP available), git state, and circle-back notes — ≤ 80%-of-screen, ending with a one-line action prompt. CAPTURE mode catches phrases like 'remind me to' or 'let's circle back' and routes them to a task or a dated memory file.
